caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden board with a grid pattern of metal nails protruding from its surface. Attached to one end of the board is a loop of cord, which connects the board to a cylindrical wooden handle. The handle is smooth and uniform in thickness, tapering slightly at one end and rounded at the other. The colors in the drawing are primarily shades of light to medium brown, depicting the natural tones and grain of the wood, with the nails shown in darker gray or black tones. The cord is a light tan color. In the lower left corner of the drawing, there is a small, simple line sketch that illustrates a hand holding the handle and striking the nail-studded board. The background is a plain, light beige color. In the bottom right, the name "Alexander Anderson" and a date "1938" are handwritten.
title: Carpet Stretching Device
